## Summary

Closes epic E09, the largest epic completed to this point in the roadmap. Records what was built against issue 0360's original design, the outcome of the plutocracy-risk discussion from issue 0387, the testnet dry-run's findings from issue 0388, and the fact that the registry's admin control has now permanently moved to governance — the single most consequential change this project has made since its MVP shipped.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Divergences from the original design are named and justified.
- [ ] The plutocracy-risk finding and its accepted-or-mitigated status is restated here for visibility, not just left in issue 0387's own document.
- [ ] The testnet dry-run's outcome (issue 0388) is summarized as the evidence basis for considering mainnet deployment.
- [ ] Any deferred question (proposal cancellation from issue 0372, if declined; the audit itself, which this epic scoped in issue 0386 but did not necessarily commission) is named as deferred.
